title: AXIAL / FOCUS STACK
hypothesis: A stack of unequal cyclic indices aligned to one fixed focus can make multi-dimensional state faster to orient and traverse while preserving source identity across ring and strip projections.
controls: moving per-ring position witness + fixed 12-o'clock gate
evidence: FIELD adapter reads the actual showcase manifest
HOUSE adapter reads the actual public spatial model
ring cardinalities are source-derived rather than forced equal
each candidate position is scored against all other currently aligned rings
zero-support positions remain inspectable but visibly dim; supported moves remain bright
RING and STRIP render the same selected indices and support relation
focus result can align rings back to an exact source identity
AXIAL focus state serializes into a reloadable URL
FIELD INDEX embedded AXIAL / LATEST can EXPAND the selected route into the full Focus Stack
AXIAL 0.5.1 transaction/projection lab remains preserved at /foundry/axial/lab-0.5.1.html
observed-use correction: current dial position was reported as insufficiently legible
moving position witness is distinct from fixed focus gate
FIELD AXIAL/LATEST and full AXIAL share /foundry/axial/focus-core.js for support/position law
/foundry/axial/research.json grounds current interaction rules in recovered donors + external human-factors evidence
promotion_gate: The AXIAL instrument is ACTIVE for ordinary orientation/re-entry. Its comparative usability and physical-embodiment claims remain unresolved under the existing evolution.evidence_gate; failure of those claims does not invalidate the working orientation utility.
research_question: Does visible support for every possible ring move let a person traverse unequal vocabularies with fewer dead ends and lower reorientation cost while preserving exact source identity?
known_gap: Support counts are exact over the loaded public source, but there is still no comparative usability result. HOUSE remains a public-safe static model, not live actuation. Physical embodiment remains unvalidated and optional.

current_classification.basis: 0.7.1 is an observed-use/human-factors correction: explicit dial position, active-ring witness, centralized focus math, and a bounded research note; no proof-state promotion.
